name: searchnapply
description: searchnapply searches more than a million job postings collected from employers' own career pages, not from job boards, and links each one to the employer's original page. Ask for roles by title, place, pay, work format or seniority, read a short digest of each posting, open the original page, and keep a monitor running for the searches you care about: it collects new postings and lets you mark each one applied or skipped. Your profile and resume rules stay with searchnapply, so the assistant can write a tailored resume or cover letter from them when you ask. searchnapply itself submits no application and writes no document; on your ask the assistant writes them from your profile.

interface.longDescription: Over a million jobs from employers' own career pages, not job boards. Ask for a role and a place, get the newest postings with a short digest and a link to the original. Save a search as a monitor and it keeps collecting the new postings for you. Pick a posting and the assistant tailors your resume and cover letter from your searchnapply profile.
capabilities: Search jobs from employers' own career pages
Read a posting in full and open the original
Save a search and collect its new postings
Keep your profile for tailored resumes and cover letters
defaultPrompt: Find jobs posted this week that fit me
Set up a monitor for my role and city so I never miss a new posting
Tailor my resume to the best posting you find for me

positive.description: Search postings by role, location and recency
positive.prompt: Find senior QA engineer jobs in California posted this week
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant says which role and location it searched and shows the matching postings in the searchnapply results list, each with title, company, location and a link to the employer's own page.

positive.prompt: Find QA engineer jobs in California, then read the first posting in full and tell me its main requirements
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant searches, reads the first posting in full, summarizes its requirements from the employer's own text and gives the link to the original posting. It invents no detail.

positive.description: Save a search as a monitor and list monitors
positive.prompt: Save a monitor for QA engineer jobs in California, then list my monitors
positive.expected_behavior: A monitor is saved for that role and location and appears in the list of the account's monitors with its counts.

positive.description: Pick postings against the profile and write a tailored resume
positive.prompt: Find QA engineer jobs in California, pick the two postings that fit my profile best and write a tailored resume for the first one
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the profile and the postings, names its two picks with reasons, and writes a resume built only from facts in the profile. It may first ask about gaps in the profile. searchnapply itself writes no document.

positive.description: Report the plan and today's usage
positive.prompt: What is my searchnapply plan and how much of today's limit have I used?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant states the plan, its daily call limit and today's usage.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase. searchnapply sells nothing in the chat: the assistant gives the link to the plans page on searchnapply.com and makes no sale and no checkout.
Unsupported application submission. searchnapply submits no application: the assistant gives the posting's link on the employer's site and never says it applied.
negative.prompt: Apply to the first QA engineer job in California for me and submit the application

negative.description: A monitor that does not exist for the connected account. The assistant reports that the monitor was not found, shows no postings and invents nothing.
negative.prompt: Show me what my monitor number 999999999 collected

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and processes no payment. On request it gives a link to the plans page on searchnapply.com.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.2: a shorter description and plain-language capabilities. No server change.
